blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The number of calls received by the National Center for Mental Health’s (NCMH) 24/7 crisis hotline has quadrupled since the COVID-19 pandemic, with a notable increase in young callers with self-harm issues. The NCMH’s main 24/7 crisis hotline can be reached at 1553 or 1800-1888-1553. According to NCMH chief Dr. Noel Reyes, calls related to suicide accounted for 10 percent of the hotline’s calls before the pandemic, but this figure has since risen to 35 percent.
